title: Ten Frame Worksheets: Making 10 for Kindergarten
intro: Use a ten-frame to show the missing part of ten.
html:
Teaching notes for parents and teachers

How to teach it

Have the student place or draw one counter in each empty box. Count the new counters separately from those already shown.

Example to work through together

Use the model below as you explain the example. Have your student point to the quantities as you discuss them.

Point to the seven pictures first. They are already in the frame and do not need another dot. Touch each empty box once: one, two, three. Draw a dot in each of those three spaces.

Now every box is occupied. Seven pictures and three new dots make ten: 7 + 3 = 10. The number to write in the answer box is 3, not 10.

Ask your student

How many empty spaces did we fill?

If your student needs help

If the student answers ten, ask for the number added rather than the completed total.
